children: Currencies including the Swedish krona and Swiss franc are emerging as preferred funding currencies for carry trades as the yen’s recent surge makes it a less reliable option, according to Bloomberg.
The move reflects a shift away from the yen, which had been a favored source of cheap funding for such trades.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Carry Traders Turn to Franc and Krona as Yen Funding Appeal Fades
